newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: AMS surges 4 pct in early Vienna trade.
newsitem.headline: AMS surges 4 pct in early Vienna trade.

text.p: Shares of Austrian semiconductor maker Austria Mikro Systeme (AMS) surged four percent in early trade in an otherwise steady Vienna market, boosted by advances in U.S. electronics shares, traders said.
At 0940 GMT, AMS was up 29 schillings at 749. The ATX index of 21 blue chips was up 1.40 points or 0.13 percent at the same time.
AMS shares shed more than 20 percent in October as investors anticipated a limp set of nine-month earnings.
The company reported a pretax profit of just 58 million schillings as losses at its subsidiaries and a floundering global semiconductor market took their toll. -- Vienna newsroom +431 53112 274
